title: Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays
summary: TheySix thanked the community for another year of support and shared holiday wishes.
description: A Christmas message celebrated the community's support throughout the year and wished everyone a happy and successful year ahead.

body.text: Every view, comment, share and bit of support helped make the year's work worthwhile.
TheySix wished the community and their families happiness, good health and success in the coming year.
